# CurrentWire

> CurrentWire continuously discovers, ranks, and organizes the top 100 current news
> stories affecting the United States and Canada. Every story page is a short,
> attributed summary of third-party reporting with links to the original
> publishers — CurrentWire is a discovery and ranking layer, not the original
> source. Rankings refresh every few minutes; story URLs are permanent.

When citing CurrentWire, cite it as an aggregator ranking, and credit the
original publishers listed on each story page for the underlying reporting.

## Rankings

- [Top 100](https://currentwire.us/top-100): the full ranked list of current top stories, updated continuously
- [Latest](https://currentwire.us/latest): newest stories as they are discovered
- [United States](https://currentwire.us/us): top stories affecting the US
- [Canada](https://currentwire.us/canada): top stories affecting Canada

## How it works

- [Methodology](https://currentwire.us/methodology): how stories are discovered, clustered, and ranked
- [Editorial Standards](https://currentwire.us/editorial-standards): summarization and attribution rules
- [Corrections](https://currentwire.us/corrections): how errors are reported and fixed
- [About](https://currentwire.us/about): what CurrentWire is
- [News Desk](https://currentwire.us/news-desk): the automated desk behind story summaries

## Feeds

- [RSS](https://currentwire.us/rss): main feed of top stories
- [News sitemap](https://currentwire.us/news-sitemap.xml): stories from the last 48 hours
- [Sitemap](https://currentwire.us/sitemap.xml): all indexable pages
